prompts.01-capa:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial photograph inside slide 1 of a Brazilian parents' Instagram carousel; no text on the photograph.
Create one new, very realistic candid photo, landscape 4:3, high resolution. A fictional Brazilian girl aged 11, warm medium-brown skin, dark brown eyes, naturally curly shoulder-length dark brown hair loosely tied back in a ponytail, wearing a plain cobalt-blue cotton T-shirt and light jeans, sits relaxed sideways on a comfortable oatmeal-colored sofa. Three-quarter view: her face is visible in natural profile, gently smiling, clearly interested and skillfully scrolling videos on an unbranded smartphone held in both hands; one thumb scrolling. The phone screen is partially visible with a colorful cooking/craft video and simple generic interface, no brand logos and no legible text. In the background, a modest tasteful home study corner with a wooden desk and open laptop showing a very softly out of focus desktop with scattered file icons. This makes the contrast between familiar smartphone use and computer files visible. Warm Brazilian afternoon daylight, natural skin and hands, no beauty filter, no studio poses, no exaggerated drama. Palette: warm cream home, blue shirt, small yellow cushion. Framing wide enough to see girl's face, hands and phone, desk distant on right; primary subject centered with breathing room for crop. No overlay, titles, letters, logos, watermark, borders or infographic. Entire image is a photograph. Do not resemble a known real person.
prompts.02-galeria:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial detail photograph inside slide 2 of a Brazilian parents' Instagram carousel; no text.
Create one high-resolution landscape 4:3 candid macro photograph of a generic black smartphone held vertically by the hands of an 11-year-old girl with medium-brown skin, blue cotton sleeve, seated on a warm beige sofa. The screen is clearly visible and in focus, showing a simple photo gallery grid of colorful everyday photographs arranged automatically: a pet dog, garden flowers, birthday cake, beach, bicycle, a drawing, sunrise, school notebook, fruit. No recognizable app brand, no people portrait collection, no text or numbers anywhere in interface. The picture explains that photographs are gathered in a gallery; it must not look like a diagram or generic empty screen. Hands naturally support the phone, five fingers on each hand, thumbs plausible. Frame much closer than an ordinary portrait: phone occupies about half the frame width, tilted only slightly, with blue fabric and sofa softly blurred behind. Soft daylight, tactile phone glass, tasteful warmth, true photographic detail. No overlay captions, logos, watermarks, border or additional phone.
prompts.04-pratica:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a new editorial photograph for slide 4 of a carousel, landscape 4:3. Input image is identity and room reference only. Keep the exact same fictional 11-year-old girl from the reference: medium-brown skin, curly dark brown ponytail, blue short-sleeved T-shirt. Do not reuse the pose or framing.
New scene: a close overhead three-quarter view of her sitting at the wooden study desk. Emphasize her small hands actively typing on a black laptop keyboard, with a mouse beside it. Part of her blue shirt and curly hair enter from the left. The laptop is angled away; its softly blurred display suggests a pale file-saving window. The keyboard, wrists, and desk are crisp and natural, screen text not readable. A parent is beside her, only a relaxed adult hand on the desk visible, not operating the keyboard or mouse. A notebook with a simple hand-drawn sun and planets without words is beside the laptop. Friendly ordinary practice, no frustration or school uniform. Warm afternoon light, rich but natural detail, blue/cream palette. Leave no unnatural blank area; it is a complete standalone photograph. No words, titles, logos, watermark, frames or collage. Important: exactly five plausible fingers per hand, no merged hands, no adult typing for her.
prompts.06-projeto:
Use case: photorealistic-natural with supporting UI insert. Create a new landscape 4:3 editorial photograph, no marketing text.
Image 1 is only the identity and home reference for the fictional girl. Preserve her exact age 11, face, curly dark hair in a ponytail, medium-brown skin, blue short-sleeved T-shirt. Image 2 is the actual Sistema Zero project-list interface and MUST be used on the laptop screen; it is a supporting insert, not the main composition. Do not redesign the app or invent a coding app.
New composition: a medium over-the-shoulder and side view of the girl sitting at a warm wooden desk, focused and gently smiling at a black laptop, right hand on a separate mouse, left resting naturally on the keyboard. We see her face in partial profile on left and the laptop screen on right. Screen shows the supplied real interface in correct perspective: 'Meus Jogos', a yellow plus card and the card 'Aventura na floresta' with green game thumbnail and blue Abrir button. Preserve this UI faithfully, with small text naturally softened by photo optics; do not add more cards or fake achievements. A small potted plant and a notebook with simple wordless sketches of trees create context. Light enters from the side. Fully new scene, different from reference sofa. Natural hands, skin, proportions, respectful candid family photography, sharp real texture. The image explains a child finding her saved project. No brand unrelated to the reference, title, watermark, overlay, borders, collage or claims of a real student.
prompts.07-conversa:
Use case: photorealistic-natural with supporting screen image. New editorial photograph for final slide of a Brazilian parenting carousel, landscape 4:3.
Reference image 1: same fictional 11-year-old girl and home as earlier, preserve her face and build, curly dark ponytail, warm medium-brown skin, blue short-sleeved T-shirt, light jeans. It is identity guidance only; make a completely new scene.
Reference image 2: an editorial generic folder window created for this carousel. Use this exact folder window on the black laptop screen, in perspective, softly readable; do not create a coding or video screen.
Scene: in the same warm study corner, a slightly wider view from the opposite front side than previous photos. Girl sits at the wooden desk; an invented Brazilian mother aged about 38 stands or sits closely beside her, wearing an oatmeal cream knit cardigan, with medium-brown skin and dark wavy shoulder-length hair, no resemblance to any real presenter. The girl happily points toward the file folder on screen while turning slightly toward her mother; the mother looks at the screen with attentive warm smile, and keeps her hands away from the mouse. Show a small ordinary shared success, not an exaggerated celebration or staged sales pose. Both faces naturally visible in three-quarter view, correct hand anatomy. Laptop remains on desk with keyboard visible, screen facing partly toward viewer and mother. Daylight, cozy neutral colors and green plant, realistic skin texture, photographic proportions. Full photograph, no title, watermark, overlay caption, subtitles, frame, collage or extra words outside the supplied screen. This is an invented illustrative family, not a testimonial.
